style: high-end 3D CGI animated short film still, realistic adult human proportions, semi-realistic 3D characters with detailed skin and expressive faces, physically based path-traced render, crisp natural light, rich warm desert colors, sharp focus, cinematic depth of field, plain unbranded clothing and props, vertical 9:16 frame
hero: Mauro, a lean tanned 39-year-old Italian man with short black hair and a short black beard, wearing a plain white baseball cap, a sweat-soaked plain white t-shirt with a white race bib printed with the large number "27" pinned on the chest, plain black running shorts, a small red backpack
hero_face: Mauro, a 39-year-old Italian man with short black hair and a short black beard

shots.image: Extreme close-up of HERO's sunburnt face, cracked dry lips, sand stuck to his sweaty skin, squinting up into a blinding white sun, bright desert sky behind him.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward his face as he squints and slowly looks up at the blazing sun, sweat runs down his cheek, hot air shimmers.

shots.image: High aerial view looking straight down at a single tiny adult man with a red backpack and white cap walking alone across an endless sea of golden sand dunes, his long shadow and a trail of footprints behind him, no one else in sight.
shots.motion: The camera rises and pulls back fast from the tiny walking man, revealing more and more endless dunes, wind blowing sand off the dune crests.

shots.image: Inside a dark abandoned stone shrine, the ceiling covered with dozens of hanging brown bats, a beam of daylight from a doorway, HERO's silhouetted hand reaching up toward one bat.
shots.motion: Slow tilt up along the hand toward the ceiling, the bats shuffle and stretch their wings, a few drop and flutter through the beam of light.

shots.image: Hundreds of adult marathon runners with backpacks and caps packed behind a start line under a big plain orange inflatable arch at dawn in the Moroccan Sahara, huge orange dunes behind, dust in the air, colorful plain triangle flags.
shots.motion: Low camera glides sideways along the start line as the runners surge forward and start running, dust kicks up, flags flutter.

shots.image: Medium shot of HERO running across firm sand among other adult runners, determined face, strong midday sun, dunes behind.
shots.motion: The camera tracks alongside HERO as he runs steadily, his backpack bouncing, other runners passing in the background, sand kicked up from his shoes.

shots.image: Aerial drone view of a long thin line of tiny runners snaking along the crest of huge golden sand dunes in the Sahara, long shadows, vast emptiness.
shots.motion: Smooth drone flight forward over the dunes following the line of tiny runners, slight banking turn.

shots.image: Ground-level close-up of a runner's feet in trail shoes with sand gaiters striking soft golden sand, sand spraying up, low sun behind.
shots.motion: Slow motion: running feet pound into the sand toward the camera, sand sprays and glitters in the sunlight, camera at ground level moving backward.

shots.image: A gigantic towering wall of orange sandstorm, hundreds of meters high, rolling across the desert toward five small adult marathon runners with backpacks on a dune in the foreground, dark orange sky.
shots.motion: The enormous sandstorm wall rolls forward and swallows the dunes, the runners turn to look, the camera slowly pushes in.

shots.image: HERO inside a raging sandstorm, everything dim orange, shielding his face with his arm, his shirt and cap whipping in the wind, sand streaking past, almost no visibility.
shots.motion: Violent wind blasts sand past the camera in streaks, HERO stumbles forward bent over against the wind, clothes flapping hard, handheld camera shake.

shots.image: HERO standing alone on top of a sand dune under a clear calm sky, turning around looking for anyone, endless empty dunes in every direction, his footprints behind him.
shots.motion: The camera slowly orbits around HERO as he turns his head left and right searching, realizing he is completely alone, light breeze.

shots.image: Close-up of HERO holding an empty crumpled plastic water bottle upside down above his open mouth, a single last drop of water falling from it, cracked lips, harsh sun glare.
shots.motion: He shakes the empty bottle above his open mouth, one last drop falls, then nothing, he lowers the bottle slowly in despair, slow push-in.

shots.image: A small abandoned whitewashed Saharan marabout tomb with a smooth round plain dome and a dark arched doorway, half buried in sand alone in the empty desert, HERO staggering toward it, late afternoon light.
shots.motion: The camera follows HERO as he staggers toward the little domed tomb, his feet dragging in the sand.

shots.image: View straight up at the inside of a dark stone dome ceiling completely covered by hundreds of hanging brown bats with folded leathery wings, a shaft of light through a small hole, dust floating, only the ceiling and the bats are visible, nobody in the frame.
shots.motion: Slow rotating camera looking up at the ceiling packed with bats, they twitch, shuffle and unfold their wings, dust drifts in the light.

shots.image: HERO sitting against a bare crumbling whitewashed wall inside the dark tomb, gaunt and exhausted, cupping in both palms a tiny live brown fruit bat, a small furry flying animal with leathery folded wings, grim desperate expression, lit by a thin beam of light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on his face as he stares at the little animal in his hands with grim resolve, its leathery wings twitch, dust floats in the light beam.

shots.image: Silhouette of HERO walking along a sharp dune ridge at sunset, huge red-orange sun on the horizon, very long shadow stretching across the sand.
shots.motion: Wide tracking shot moving sideways with HERO as he walks slowly along the ridge against the setting sun.

shots.image: HERO lying exhausted on his back in the thin shade of a small dry thorny bush at midday, eyes half closed, blinding white-hot sand all around, clear sky.
shots.motion: Heat haze shimmers over the sand, HERO's chest rises and falls slowly, his hand twitches, slow overhead descent toward him.

shots.image: HERO collapsing on his knees in the sand near low dark woven nomad tents, a Berber woman in a long indigo robe and headscarf with goats rushing toward him, early morning light.
shots.motion: The nomad woman runs toward the collapsing man, goats scatter, camera slowly pushes in, dust in the warm light.

shots.image: HEROFACE, now very thin and gaunt with hollow cheeks and no cap, wearing a pale blue hospital gown, lying in a hospital bed with an IV drip in his arm, a doctor in a white coat beside him, soft window light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward his tired face as he slowly opens his eyes and breathes, the doctor checks the IV drip.

shots.image: HEROFACE standing shirtless in front of a bathroom mirror, no cap, shockingly skinny with visible ribs and hollow cheeks, touching his hollow cheek with his hand, his gaunt reflection staring back at him.
shots.motion: Slow push-in on the mirror as he slowly turns his face and touches his hollow cheek, staring at his reflection.

shots.image: HERO, healthy again and smiling with confidence, standing at the start line of the desert marathon among many adult runners under a plain white inflatable arch, golden morning light.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward HERO's confident smile as the crowd cheers behind him and he adjusts his cap, ready to run.

shots.image: Heroic low-angle shot of HERO running straight toward the camera over a sand dune at sunrise with other runners behind him, sun flare behind his head, sand flying from his feet.
shots.motion: HERO runs toward the camera which moves backward low to the ground, sand flying from his steps, golden sun flare, triumphant.
